memberdef.name: DO_NOP_OP_GENERIC
memberdef.initializer: int \ xrow_update_op_do_nop_##op_type(struct xrow_update_op *op, \ struct xrow_update_field *field) \ { \ assert(field->type == XUPDATE_NOP); \ int key_len_or_index; \ if (xrow_update_bar_locate(op, field, &key_len_or_index) != 0) \ return -1; \ if (xrow_update_op_do_##op_type(op, field->bar.point) != 0) \ return -1; \ return xrow_update_bar_finish(field); \ }

memberdef.name: DO_BAR_OP_GENERIC
memberdef.initializer: int \ xrow_update_op_do_bar_##op_type(struct xrow_update_op *op, \ struct xrow_update_field *field) \ { \ assert(field->type == XUPDATE_BAR); \ field = xrow_update_route_branch(field, op); \ if (field == NULL) \ return -1; \ return xrow_update_op_do_field_##op_type(op, field); \ }

briefdescription.para: Finish bar creation only when it is fully initialized and valid.

detaileddescription.para: Because if all this is happening inside an upsert() operation, an error in the bar won't stop the whole xrow upsert. This field will still be saved in the result tuple. But in case of an error this operation should be skipped. So this is kept 'nop' when error happens.

briefdescription.para: Locate a field to update by op's JSON path and initialize field as a bar update.

parameterdescription.para: One parameter for two values, depending on where the target point is located: in an array or a map. In case of map it is size of a key before the found point. It is used to find range of the both key and value in '#' operation to drop the pair. In case of array it is index of the array element to be able to check how many fields are left for deletion.

briefdescription.para: Locate an optional field to update by op's JSON path.

detaileddescription.para: If found or only a last path part is not found, initialize field as a bar update. Last path part may not exist and it is ok, for example, for '!' and '=' operations.

briefdescription.para: Nop fields are those which are not updated.

detaileddescription.para: And when they receive an update via one of xrow_update_op_do_nop_* functions, it means, that there is a non terminal path digging inside this not updated field. It turns nop field into a bar field. How exactly - depends on a concrete operation.

memberdef.argsstring: (struct xrow_update_field *field, struct json_tree *format_tree, struct json_token *this_node, char *out, char *out_end)
